name: Anubhab
title: Backend & Full-Stack Developer
tagline: APIs, real-time systems, and the products around them.
intro: I design backend services and the interfaces in front of them — from EV charging platforms to collaborative tools — with a bias toward clear APIs, careful auth, and software that stays understandable.

about.heading: About
about.bio: I am a backend and full-stack developer finishing a B.Tech in Electrical Engineering. Most of my work sits on the server: Spring Boot and FastAPI services, PostgreSQL, and the protocols that connect devices to those services. I also build the Next.js interfaces those systems need when the product has to be used by people, not just other machines.

highlights.text: Comfortable owning a feature from the API contract through persistence, auth, and a typed frontend.
Interested in protocols and infrastructure — OCPP charging sessions, WebSockets, and services that stay boring under load.
